items.title: Accurate Rhythm Analysis

items.question: Is your biorhythm accurate?
items.answer: It boasts high accuracy based on biorhythm theory that has been proven for decades.

items.title: Know the optimal time
items.description: We will tell you the optimal timing when planning important events.
items.question: How do I use it?
items.answer: You can get better results if you plan important meetings, exercise, study, etc. on days when your rhythm is good.

items.title: Condition management
items.description: You can know and prepare for changes in daily condition in advance.
items.question: Do I need to check it every day?
items.answer: Yes, your biorhythm changes every day, so it’s good to check it regularly.

items.title: 3 types of rhythm analysis
items.description: We analyze your physical, emotional, and intellectual rhythms respectively.
items.question: What rhythm can you recognize?
items.answer: You can check the three rhythms of the physical (23 days), emotional (28 days), and intellectual (33 days) cycles.

items.title: completely free
items.description: All features are available for free
items.question: Does it cost anything?
items.answer: It is provided completely free of charge, and you can use it right away without registering as a member.

items.title: Easy to use
items.description: Just enter your date of birth and you can check the results right away.
items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: You can check the results immediately after entering your date of birth.

items.title: What is biorhythm?
items.description: It is a biological rhythm that represents periodic changes in the body, emotions, and intellect.
items.question: What is biorhythm?
items.answer: It refers to a pattern of changes in the body, emotions, and intellect that repeats in a certain cycle from the day of birth.

items.title: How to use it
items.description: Place important schedules on days with good rhythm.
items.question: How do I use it?
items.answer: It is better to do important work on high rhythm days and rest on low rhythm days.

items.title: accuracy
items.description: It is based on scientifically proven theory.
items.question: How accurate is it?
items.answer: Although there may be individual differences, it is said to match the rhythm that many people actually experience.

items.title: Cycle Description
items.description: Each rhythm has its own cycle
items.question: What is the cycle?
items.answer: It repeats in cycles of 23 days for the body, 28 days for emotions, and 33 days for intellect.

items.title: free service
items.description: All features are provided for free
items.question: Does it cost anything?
items.answer: It's completely free and has no ads.

items.title: sharing function
items.description: You can compare your biorhythm with your friends
items.question: Can you share?
items.answer: Yes, you can easily share it with a link and compare it with your friends.

items.title: Real-time analysis
items.description: Check today’s biorhythm in real time
items.question: When do I check?
items.answer: Checking it every morning helps me plan my day.

items.title: future prediction
items.description: You can check future rhythm changes in advance.
items.question: Can you see the future?
items.answer: Yes, you can check your biorhythm up to one month in advance.

items.title: graph provided
items.description: Identify rhythm changes at a glance with intuitive graphs
items.question: Is it easy to see?
items.answer: Anyone can easily understand the colorful graphs.

items.title: personalized advice
items.description: We recommend activities that fit your current rhythm.
items.question: Can I get some advice?
items.answer: Yes, we will inform you of activities and precautions appropriate for each rhythm condition.

items.title: Compatibility analysis
items.description: Check your biorhythm compatibility with a friend or lover.
items.question: Can you also see compatibility?
items.answer: If you enter the date of birth of two people, we will analyze your biorhythm compatibility.

items.title: Notification function
items.description: We will notify you in advance of changes in the rhythm of important days.
items.question: Can I get notifications?
items.answer: You can set a biorhythm notification for the desired date.

hero.subtitle: Check your condition today and plan the optimal day.

physical.high: Physical vitality is at its peak. With the energy of the stars supporting your activities, this is the perfect time to tackle that energy-intensive task or exercise you've been putting off.
physical.medium: Energy maintains a stable and harmonious flow. It is a peaceful time to maintain a regular routine and engage in moderate activity and movement.
physical.low: The universe invites you to pause, take care of yourself, and recharge. Today, listen to your body and relax. Excessive activity can cause you to tire more easily than usual.
physical.critical: You are at a turning point where your energy may be very powerful but somewhat unstable. It's a good idea to be careful with every move, be aware of your limits, and act consciously.

emotional.high: It is a day when the doors of the heart are wide open and emotional light emanates strongly. It is a wonderful time for interaction with loved ones, creative expression, and fun gatherings.
emotional.medium: Emotional waves remain calm and clear. It is a very appropriate state for having balanced relationships and communication with people around you with a peaceful mind.
emotional.low: Today is a day when your mind can become somewhat delicate and sensitive. Find and stay in a comfortable environment that warms your emotions and gives you peace and comfort.
emotional.critical: Emotional energy can swirl and be very intense. Be careful not to lose your balance, and even if sudden emotional changes come, face them calmly with deep breathing.

intellectual.high: This is a moment when your mental clarity shines more than ever. It's the perfect time to solve complex problems, make important strategic decisions, or delve deeper into new areas of interest.
intellectual.medium: It is a time when thoughts become clear and organized. It's a good energy to handle tasks that require logical tasks or clear communication and to steadily move toward your goals.
intellectual.low: Your intellectual focus may feel like it's in a soft fog. Instead of trying to overanalyze, put your thoughts aside for a moment. Sometimes the best insights come in silence.
intellectual.critical: Intellectual energy is high but somewhat scattered. Rather than jumping to conclusions, it is a wise choice to focus on one thought at a time and make careful and careful decisions.
